tool_calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent CH03 adult female Lumi combat sprite source, E direction poses B.
Image1 is E sheet A reference for EXACT identity, EAST side-view direction, anatomy standing scale, painterly style and costume. Image2 is portrait identity supporting reference; omit its pet/background. This is a NEW four-pose sheet B, not an edit of A poses.
Create native2048x2048 transparent PNG; if tool actual is1254x1254, preserve that native output without upscaling. Exactly FOUR isolated full-body sprites in a2x2 sheet. Every cell has clear35px transparent margin all around including against outer canvas and internal divider. Leave extra top transparency above complete staff; staff tip must not touch frame. Entire hat/staff/dress/boots are visible. Occupied whole silhouette height target540-550px at actual1254, anatomy from hair top(EXCLUDING HAT) to mean foot contact450-500px. Match sheetA BODY scale, but keep hat/staff compact enough to fit, no body shrinking. No grid/text/background/floor/shadow.
Lumi is22yo ADULT WOMAN, full bust in complete fitted bodice, narrow waist, slender shoulders/arms/calves, shapely proportionate NOT thick/fat/chibi. Chestnut curly hair, obsidian black/midnight purple witchhat, cinched waist mid-length layered arcane dress with silver crescent stitch, black crescent boots. Tall black/silver star-ring crescent staff with violet crystal and contained ghost-blue magical glow. No pet. Dark clothes have warm clear dimensional highlights. Premium hand-painted volumetric warm-light cartoon fantasy, elevated near-isometric2.5D.
ALL sprites genuinely face EAST screen-right heading0°. Mainly RIGHT PROFILE: nose directed right horizontally with one main eye, chest in side-view, hat brim and both boot toes point horizontally RIGHT. NOT southeast. Match image1's corrected rightward profile and redraw body per pose. Never mirror/rotate whole sprite.
TOP LEFT basic_release: balanced feet, staff side-upright held with one hand, free hand extends decisively screen-right pointing to unseen target to command pet. EMPTY air, pet not drawn, face not blocked.
TOP RIGHT basic_recovery: same feet and scale, free hand retracts to chest/waist and body returns toward neutral balance, staff side-upright.
BOTTOM LEFT dash: low torso leaning screen-right, quick wide stepping forward towards screen-right with both boots visible and separated under skirt, staff carried naturally and entirely visible, NO motion trails or FX.
BOTTOM RIGHT guard_cast: both hands grip the staff in front of torso, star-ring staff lifted FORWARD toward screen-right for concentrated defensive casting; staff/head clear, retain face visibility, stable two-foot brace. No detached spell circle or pet.
Only the4 requested complete figures, keep costume/face/scale consistent with reference A. Avoid old cream/pink/lilac/teal palette, beard/male engineer, oversized hat compressing body, southeast angle, floor/contact shadow, pet/companion, trail, text/watermark.

landmark_annotation.coordinate_space: Original native1254x1254 PNG, x right and y down; no cropping/scaling/packing performed.
landmark_annotation.method: Manual visual annotation of face center, hand grip, top tip of glowing central violet crystal, visible hair top excluding hat, and mean of two sole-contact center points. Pillow/numpy used only read-measure alpha and connected components. Error bounds are estimates, not calibrated certainty.
landmark_annotation.foot_definition: Arithmetic mean of TWO boot sole-contact centers; rear sole obscured by skirt explicitly estimated.
landmark_annotation.hair_definition: Visible top of chestnut hair below brim; hat and staff excluded. Occluded hair/sole locations are visual estimates.
landmark_annotation.muzzle_definition: Top visible tip of glowing central violet staff crystal, excluding silver crown point; manually estimated.
landmark_annotation.normalization: None. Runtime processor must use one fixed direction idle reference for all poses and preserve crouch height; do not enlarge each dash/guard pose to standing height.

visual_review.handedness: E pair accepted by root; A forward staff hand vs B rear staff carry may differ anatomically. Later sources fixed left staff/right command.

pending_checks: Built-in tool returned native1254square; native2K requirement not met, no upscale applied.
Some full silhouettes cross invisible cell bounds or have less than35px margin. Four characters are separate connected components but rectangular bboxes can contain neighbor pixels.

Runtime processor must separate connected components with manual head/foot/grip seeds, retain same-body staff/hat detail and clean only measured low-alpha external noise under user-authorized local frame processing.
Direction-wide fixed idle scale/anchor review and complete12-direction family review required before production.
notes: Original raw output copied without software editing. Wrong-direction and multi-arm rejected intermediates remain only CODEX generated_images. No portrait, previous basic source, loader, manifest, tools code, Godot execution, or commit changed.
